description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {W}.
When Ornithopter dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {1}.
Repeat.
